== English errata comparison sources ==
The 2013 replacement puts the imprisonment explanation and once-per-captivity limit into the card text. The earlier Decipher Supplement explains delivery, release and recapture in a ruling. The Lost Pile choice and loss of the Effect are retained.

Players Committee, Decipher Errata, official text as of 1 January 2013, PDF page 9. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20160809094140id_/http://www.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/DecipherErrata.pdf#page=9 Internet Archive]. Players Committee, [https://wiki.swccg.com/images/a/a0/PC-Decipher-Errata-June-2017.pdf#page=9 Decipher Errata], official text as of June 2017, PDF page 9. Players Committee, [https://wiki.swccg.com/images/3/3d/SWCCG_2023_AdvancedRulebook.pdf#page=128 2023 Advanced Rulebook], Appendix A, PDF page 128. [[:File:CC-D-specialdelivery.gif|Complete replacement face]]. Related ruling: Decipher, [https://wiki.swccg.com/images/f/ff/Decipher_Glossary_Supplement.pdf#page=7 Glossary Supplement], updated 29 January 2002, PDF page 7. The original Wiki identifier 5_123o remains on the printed article. GEMP’s pinned source has no class or mapping for that suffix.
